                          CONSOLIDATED ACCOUNT STATEMENT
                            01-Apr-2024 To 31-Mar-2025

>>> SYNTHETIC. No real PAN, folio, email or holding appears here.
>>> A real CAS is Zone B personal data and can never be committed, so this file
>>> reproduces the CAMS layout with invented values. Every trap in
>>> MODULE_1.md §5.4 is present, and each is labelled at the line it exercises.
>>> Money is computed, not hand-typed: units x nav ties to the amount net of
>>> stamp duty on every row, which is the arithmetic the importer checks.
>>>
>>> Lines beginning '>>>' are this file's own commentary and are NOT part of
>>> the layout. `load_cas_fixture` strips them before parsing, the same way
>>> `load_transactions` strips '>' from transactions.csv. They are deliberately
>>> NOT in the parser's noise allowlist: a fixture that taught the parser to
>>> ignore an unfamiliar line would be teaching it the one habit this module
>>> exists to prevent.

PAN: XXXXX0000X                              Email: investor@example.invalid

>>> The other leg of the switch, in a different scheme block, same folio.
>>> Charges sit between the legs and neither stores the same figure:
>>>   56,486.79 gross out
>>>    -  564.87 exit load        -> 55,921.92 actually switched
>>>    -    2.80 stamp duty       -> 55,919.12 actually invested
>>> §5.8 compares the STORED amounts, 56,486.79 against 55,919.12, and misses
>>> by Rs 567.67 against a Rs 1.00 tolerance. Both figures are percentages of
>>> the switch, so widening the tolerance only moves where linking starts to
>>> fail. The shared figure is 55,921.92, and both legs reconstruct it.
